attributes.title: 2027 Chicago Dental Society Midwinter Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Chicago Dental Society holds its 2027 Midwinter Meeting February 25 to 27, 2027, at 2301 S. Indiana Avenue in Chicago, the McCormick Place West address. The meeting combines lectures, hands-on courses and a large exhibit hall, and CDS lists it under its Events & CE section with a "Claim CE" service for attendees.

Course-level CE hours, fees and the provider statement for 2027 are published on the meeting's registration platform, which we could not open, so they are not listed here yet. CDS members register free of charge; check the official site for non-member and team rates.
